items.title: University of Tokyo holds 'Tokyo Forum 2026' with AI as its theme (Nov 20-21)
items.summary_en: According to a search-result snippet, the University of Tokyo is holding the public international symposium 'Tokyo Forum 2026' at Yasuda Auditorium on 20-21 November 2026, with AI as the theme. Keynote speakers reportedly include Anne Bouverot, the French presidential AI envoy. Only the announcement was seen; no talk content or outcomes were available.
items.source_name: University of Tokyo (event announcement PDF, as surfaced via web search)
items.notes: Original in Japanese. The date is the event start date, not a verified publication date of the announcement. The PDF itself could not be fetched (u-tokyo.ac.jp not reachable), so the details come from a search snippet only. Event announcement, not a research result.

coverage_note: Direct fetch was BLOCKED: aip.riken.jp and www.riken.jp failed DNS resolution (ENOTFOUND), meaning they are outside the session's allowed network domains. These hosts need to be added to the session's network allowlist. u-tokyo.ac.jp was not fetched directly. Fallback WebSearch (Japanese and English queries) found no RIKEN AIP or University of Tokyo AI research press release dated 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-21. The latest RIKEN items surfaced were from June-October 2026, outside the collection window: the AI for Science supercomputer named 'RIKYU' (2026-06-19), a feature on AI for Science (2026-07-22), and a closeup feature (2026-10-19). Search indexes may lag, so this is not proof that nothing was published. Only one low-substance item (the Tokyo Forum event) is reported.
